programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 3 Hurricanes visit the No. 18 Seminoles. Miami leads the rivalry series 36-33 after beating Florida State 36-14 in 2024. FSU is coming off a double-overtime loss to Virginia on Sept. 26. Miami last played Sept. 20, beating Florida 26-7.

programs.title: Authentic ACC
programs.desc: In this edition of the series produced by Louisville Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 Louisville Cardinals.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Cardinals (4-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against a tough foe in the No. 2 Hurricanes (5-0, 1-0). Louisville dropped its first game of the season in a 30-27 overtime decision versus Virginia on Oct. 4. Miami defeated Louisville 52-45 last year.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Wolfpack (6-5, 3-4 ACC) host the rival Tar Heels (4-7, 2-5). NC State seeks a fifth straight win over North Carolina. UNC will miss the postseason in Bill Belichick's first campaign at the helm. The Wolfpack will play a fourth straight bowl game.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Golden Bears play the No. 15 Cardinals for the first time. Louisville won its third straight game Nov. 1 when it took care of Virginia Tech, 28-16 on the road. California's Kendrick Raphael has scored six touchdowns across his past two games.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The Tar Heels (2-3, 0-1 ACC) try to right the ship when they face the Golden Bears (4-2, 1-1). Bill Belichick's first conference game at the helm of North Carolina was one to forget, as Dabo Swinney's Clemson dismantled the Tar Heels 38-10 on Oct. 4.
